g.text: Digital Ticket Service — C3 Component Diagram
Digital Ticket Service (Issue · Delivery API · Validate · Notify)
order CONFIRMED only · idempotent re-issue (UUID code)
event + seat snapshot baked into each ticket
1. Tickets issued only for CONFIRMED orders
2. One ticket per order item (order_item_id unique)
3. Unique ticketCode (UUID) — QR / pass payload key
4. Issue is idempotent — re-issue returns existing tickets
5. Validation flips VALID → USED exactly once
7. Confirmation notice sent after order confirmed
